actors.name: HR Department
actors.private_context: HR wants a high response rate to make the survey results credible. They have prepared the survey and will send the initial invitation and reminders according to a standard schedule.

actors.name: Employees (400 individuals)
actors.private_context: Each employee has their own workload, interest in the survey, and tendency to respond to workplace surveys. Some may complete it early, some late, some not at all.

shared_context: Calloway Regional Hospital has 400 employees. The annual engagement survey will be open from 2026-09-01T08:00:00-05:00 to 2026-09-15T17:00:00-05:00. Employees can complete the survey online via a link sent to their work email. HR will send an initial invitation at the start and periodic reminders. Participation is voluntary and anonymous.

starting_events.description: HR sends the initial survey invitation email to all 400 employees with a link to the survey.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 60 employees submitted a completed survey response before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
